name: Vietnam Hosting — Arch Linux (NAT Linux Container)
description: Unprivileged Arch Linux NAT Linux container compatible with Pterodactyl Console, Wings SFTP, user-space SSH (pubkey-only), persistent storage, and container-safe task scheduling. Not a KVM VPS (no root/systemd/privileged mode). Official Docker Hub archlinux:base image supports AMD64 only (ARM64 is not officially published by Arch Linux).

privileged_requirements.notes: Runs completely unprivileged inside standard Pterodactyl Wings isolation.
